motion.text:
MOTION STORYBOARD (lib/motion.ts tokens; CSS: ./tokens.css --nv-*)

Unit switch (rail → desk): see the round 3 note below (it replaces the round 1 sequence).

Marker disclosure
  L0→L1  hint fades in, drops 2px (hint 140ms, iOS ease-out; CSS only)
  L1→L2  card: opacity + translateY(-4px) + scale .98→1
         (card 220ms, emphasized decelerate); other margin items dim
         to 35% (dimOthers 160ms); the pin tone locks
  L2→L3  sheet slides 24px from the right on SPRING.gentle; scrim
         fades (scrim 160ms, ease-out); the cited fragment pulses once
         (pulse 900ms after pulseDelay 280ms, ease-out)
  close  card exits (cardExit 160ms), sheet exits (sheetExit 200ms),
         both accelerate

Disposition
  press  buttons compress to .97 (SCALE.press, pressIn 80ms)
  swap   the dock's state leaves (dockExit 120ms), the next rises
         (dockRise 240ms, emphasized decelerate)

Reduced motion: opacity only (reduced 150ms, ease-out) or instant;
the pulse becomes a static tint.
Animate transform and opacity only; never blur.

motion3.text:
ROUND 3 MICRO-INTERACTIONS (lib/motion.ts tokens)

Sticky file header
  stuck     shadow fades in (stuck 160ms, standard); corners square at once
  merged    position and layout icons drop 3px into place
            (stuckEnter 180ms, emphasized decelerate); out: stuckExit 140ms
  release   header leaves with its file (native sticky)
  Viewed    box fills (check 140ms), file folds,
            chevron −90° (chevron 200ms)

Jump from briefing chip
  0ms       smooth scroll, lands below the sticky header
  arrive    range tint holds (landHold 275ms), then fades
            (landFade 825ms, emphasized accelerate)
  reduced   instant scroll, static tint until next action

Gap row
  open      the next rows appear in place, no motion (the renderer
            re-renders them)
Read-only neighbor
  show      its rows rise 8px from .98, origin bottom (dockRise 240ms,
            emphasized decelerate); Show/Hide chevron (chevron 200ms)

Margin pin
  hover     lines tint (lineTint 140ms); peek drops 2px
            (hint 140ms, iOS ease-out)
  open      card scale .98 → 1 (card 220ms, emphasized decelerate)

Unit switch
  0ms       rail row selects, its glyph turns into a spinner
            (workingSpin 900ms)
  150ms     old unit dims to 45% (switchDim 160ms after switchWait 150ms)
            if the next unit hasn't arrived
  arrive    scroll to top; the page regions enter (PAGE)

All: transform/opacity only, real hover only,
focus-visible for keyboard, reduced motion = opacity or instant.

motion4.text:
DELIVERY DIAL STORYBOARD (lib/motion.ts · delivery-choreography.ts)

/* one height movement per stop change; layers never animate their own size */
PHASED SEQUENCE (ms from the stop change; Explained → Guided)
  thumb            0    SPRING.snappy (slight overshoot)
  leaving blocks   0    fade out last-first, 27.5ms apart
                        (deliveryChildStagger / 2), hint 140ms,
                        emphasized accelerate; fade only, no drop
  height move      210  when the last leaving block is at 30% opacity
                        (--nv-share-morph-start-opacity, 13ms before
                        it is out): old total → new total once,
                        card 220ms, EASE.standard (no overshoot);
                        transform-only FLIP, nothing clipped
  arriving blocks  287  at 75% of the move (--nv-share-content-start,
                        77ms in), 27.5ms apart in reading order;
                        fade over hint 140ms, rise 2px (OFFSET.hint)
                        over card 220ms, standard decelerate
  in by            564
Nothing leaves: the move starts at the change. Same total: no move;
the blocks cross over in order. The flow card stays still.

Glyph: the bars fill left → right and empty right → left; each starts
when the one before has made 85% of its travel
(--nv-share-chain-threshold: 125ms on SPRING.snappy).
Quick return: reverses from where things are; a block still on screen
comes straight back, a moving height turns toward the new total.
No queue, no replay.

Reduced motion: the thumb snaps; the height snaps once and blocks fade
in place over reduced 150ms, together; no move, rise or stagger.
Transform/opacity only; never blur.
